runs.note: Answer 10: she can help them vote
turns: How do I get an absentee ballot in here? I ain't missed an election since 1964.
runs.reply: Since 1964, that is something to be proud of. The facility is required to help you get your ballot, and you can always ask the social worker or the front desk to help you get the paperwork started.
